scores.evidence: There are three can-do objectives, and each is assessed two or more times with objectiveId: o1 by q1, q2, e1 and e2; o2 by q3 (apply), e3 (apply, new home-path case) and e4; o3 by q4, e5 and e6. The rebuilt e3 (`Read(~/.aws/**)` in user settings) now tests writing a rule for a new case.

hook-b1 sets a concrete scene in three sentences (an unknown repo, 「READMEのとおりに準備して」, a leftover `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` with API spelled out) and ends with 「何が起こりうるでしょうか。」. The ungraded multi-select q0 follows, and its explanation points ahead to 10-1, 10-2 and 10-5. There is no trivia or statistic.

The new qualifier in s2-isolate, 「`--bare` なしの `claude -p`」, is not glossed here. It is taught in 第9回, which is a listed prerequisite (cc-09 practice and its exam use `claude --bare -p`), so it is fair prior knowledge. s5-md2 now defines 「[[エフォート]]（effort）は、考える量の設定です。」 before s5-table uses it. The 第6回 and 第7回 gap (CLAUDE.md, スキル, サブエージェント) is unchanged.

measure.mjs: 「prose 1896 (budget 1,200–2,400) · read 2468 · practice reading 1072 · questions 11 · est 17.2 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 17)」, so estMinutes 17 still matches, and strict lint reports 0 warnings. The 2-column tables (s2-table, s5-table) are lighter to scan. s5-md2's second paragraph now packs three unrelated facts (`-p` and the key, `/clear` vs `/compact`, the definition of エフォート) in front of the table as a 「補足」. s2 is still 7 blocks long.

s3-steps still works the example in four labelled subgoals with reasons, and s3-code now matches the renamed target (`Read(./config/secret.json)` agrees with ex-target 「`config/secret.json` と `keys/` に決まります。」). ex-target still gives no reason for its choice, and there is no faded step between the full example and p-deny.

The inline checks q1–q4 and the exam are unchanged. Because s2-table now reads 「オフラインのコンテナかVMだけで使う」, e2-b (「ネットにつながらないコンテナやVMの中で使う」) no longer repeats a table cell word for word. q2 can still be answered by matching words, since its key mirrors s2-table row 2 and s2-isolate, and its hint points at the VM box.

Each distractor encodes a misconception from the brief, and its feedback corrects it with a reason in two sentences or fewer. Examples: q2-b 「サンドボックスが守るのはシェルコマンドだけです」, q3-c (reads run without allow rules), e3-b and e3-d (`/` is not absolute, `./` is not home), e4-b 「拒否ルールは、どの権限モードでも効きます」, e5-b (`/usage` is an estimate), e6-a (`/compact` is a large request). The round-1 problems in the e3 and e4 corrections are gone.

s2-layers keeps 5 nodes and 2 subgraphs, and its labels are shorter for mobile (「シェル
コマンド」, 「ファイル操作・MCP
（サンドボックス外）」). The caption now states the takeaway in two sentences: 「VMやクラウドセッションはClaude Code全体を、サンドボックスはシェルコマンドだけを囲みます。」 Hooks are still missing from the diagram, although s2-sandbox, e2-c and card-sandbox say they run outside the sandbox.

practice-folder now puts one command per line (`mkdir cc-practice`, `cd cc-practice`, `git init`, …), which is easier to copy and debug. practice-case-zshrc reads 「（副業用のキー）」, and both changes are harmless. The audit, deny and bill tasks keep their expect, hint and troubleshoot, the model answers agree, and the checklist is unchanged. The hint ladder is still one or two levels.

summary-points (3 points covering o1–o3) comes after the exam. summary-next now opens with a reflection question (「自分の環境で、田中さんと同じ状態になっているものはありますか。」) and names 第11回 as the next step. summary-cards has 7 cards, all on content the body teaches (card-clear is now backed by s5-table), and askTutor follows.

The new s2-isolate qualifier matches the audit quote 「Without `--bare`, a `-p` session runs the hooks in a project's `.claude/settings.json` and connects the servers in its `.mcp.json`」. The facts that moved into s5-md2 (`-p` uses `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` without approval; 「`/clear` は費用がかかりませんが、`/compact` は…それ自体が大きな要求です」) match facts-cc-10 line 210, and s5-md2 now cites cc-authentication and cc-model-config. The s2-table cell 「オフラインのコンテナかVM」 matches 「containers, VMs, or dev containers without internet access」.

The s2-layers caption and alt now use です・ま す (「守りは重ねて使います。」, 「…に入る図です。」), and s5-md2 stays in です・ます. Table cells use plain form, which is acceptable. 「下の表の補足です。」 is serviceable but flat, and s2-table's 「オフライン」 differs from the 「ネットにつながらない」 used in e1-b, e2-b and practice-prompt-review ①.

The s2-layers alt is specific and fuller than before. It names the flow, what the sandbox encloses, and 「VM・クラウドセッションの枠は、Claude Code全体を囲みます。」 It also names items the shortened labels no longer show (「分類器」, 「子プロセス」). The 2-column tables suit mobile, but the diagram's rendering still needs the visual-qa screenshots.

niceToHave: s2-table now says 「オフラインのコンテナかVMだけで使う」, while e1-b feedback, e2-b, the e2 explanation and practice-prompt-review ① say 「ネットにつながらない…」. Pick one phrase for the whole lesson. One option: keep the table as is and change practice-prompt-review ① to 「…既定から外し、オフラインのコンテナかVMの中だけで使います。」 so that e2-b stays a paraphrase rather than a copy.

s5-md2's second paragraph bundles three unrelated facts in front of the table. Consider splitting it so each fact sits next to its row, e.g. keep 「[[エフォート]]（effort）は、考える量の設定です。」 and move 「`-p` では、環境変数の `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` が承認なしで使われます。」 into the row-1 cause cell as 「APIの請求が届いた：`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` を承認した（`-p` では承認なしで使われる）」.

s2-layers still leaves out hooks. Add `F["リポジトリのフック
（サンドボックス外）"]` inside VMBOX, outside SBOX, with no edge from C. That gives 6 nodes and matches s2-sandbox, e2-c and card-sandbox.
s2-layers alt mentions 「分類器」 and 「子プロセス」, which the shortened labels no longer show. Either keep the alt in step with the labels or add 「（拒否・確認・分類器）」 back under 「権限ルールと承認」.
Still open from round 1, in unchanged content: ex-target (s3-steps) gives no reason for its choice. Consider 「漏れると困る鍵のファイルを挙げます。Claudeが読んだ中身は、会話としてAnthropicに送られます。」
Still open from round 1: add 「第6回｜CLAUDE.mdで前提を伝える」 and 「第7回｜手順はスキルに、調べものはサブエージェントに」 to prerequisites.
Still open from round 1: q2's hint 「Claude Code全体を囲めるのはどれか、図で確かめましょう。」 points at the answer. Consider 「フックやMCPサーバーまで囲めるのはどれか、考えましょう。」
summary: This is a verification round: review-scope exited 0 with 9 of 44 blocks changed (11%) and sections and objectives unchanged. The previous review had no must-fix items, so `resolved` is empty. All 9 changed blocks were reviewed in full. The `--bare` qualifier in s2-isolate matches the audit quote and relies on 第9回, which is a listed prerequisite. s3-steps and s3-code agree on `config/secret.json`, and nothing else references the old name. The table facts moved into s5-md2 are cited and accurate, and the tables are now 2 columns. No changed block introduces an error or a regression. The remaining points are a wording inconsistency (オフライン vs ネットにつながらない), a dense 「補足」 paragraph, and hooks still missing from the diagram, all in niceToHave. validate and strict lint are clean, and measure.mjs gives est 17.2 min against estMinutes 17. Mean 3.38, every criterion ≥ 3, verdict pass.
